long-two-sentences.text: The man who lived in the small white house at the end of the long road that ran beside the river told the children who came to visit him every morning that he had once sailed around the world on a ship that carried tea and spices from the far east to the cold ports of the north. long-paragraphs.text: We reached the top of the hill. Below us lay the whole valley. A river ran through it like a silver thread. I had never seen anything so still. We stood there until the light began to fade. The train left the station at six. By seven it had crossed the river. By eight the hills were behind us, and the sea was in front. The market opens early. Farmers bring their fruit before the sun is up, and the first buyers are there by five. By noon the best of it is gone. Remove the cover. Lift the old filter out and throw it away. Slide the new filter in until it stops. Put the cover back. Run the machine for a minute to be sure. You have seen the house. You have met the neighbors. You know the price. Will you buy it? I need an answer by Friday. The farmer had cows, sheep, pigs, and one very old horse. The horse did no work. It just stood in the field and watched the road. Plant the seeds in a row. Cover them with a little soil, and water them every evening. In a week you should see the first leaves.
